set.approach: The winter way in follows the Fundy Trail Parkway access road, which is not plowed in cold months; with little snow an all-wheel-drive vehicle may get part of the way, and otherwise it is a long ski or snowshoe. set.approach: Coming down from the Deliverance climbs, a flagged path runs beside the brook on the right bank to the base of the falls. The Walton Glen trail itself starts from the Fundy Trail Parkway access road, which is not plowed in winter, so expect a long ski or snowshoe if snow is thin; the last section drops from the lookout to the brook. Center Face is on the broad frozen waterfall, a short way downstream from Deliverance; it is hard to miss.
set.descent_text: Rappel the route with double ropes.

review.notes: Area pages for access and trail; route page for the rappel where stated.
